references.title: LU Raises (Lateral Raises) | LU Xiaojun training during AWC2020
references.observed: Actual paused video frames at 0, 3.992 and 5 seconds reviewed. Plates rise outward through overhead range with long arms; shoulders rotate upward. This is a motion reference, not our athlete/style/equipment reference.

Primary coaching description names this AKA Lu Raise; arms stay close to straight, weights move out to sides then overhead, arms externally rotate naturally, palms face more forward at top, controlled return.

confirmedCurrentDefects: The existing top drawing stops in a broad high V instead of the fuller overhead endpoint required by the catalogue and demonstration.
